Imports

../tls13, ../types

Types

TrafficSecrets = object
  clientSecret*: seq[byte]
  serverSecret*: seq[byte]
  suite*: Tls13Suite
  haveClient*: bool
  haveServer*: bool
TLS 1.3 traffic secrets captured from a keylog. Note: keylog lines carry no suite name — set suite yourself from the negotiated cipher (e.g. OpenSSL's SSL_get_cipher_name) before calling roleKeyMaterial.

proc parseKeylogLine(line: string; secrets: var TrafficSecrets) {.
    ...raises: [ValueError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Fold one NSS keylog line into secrets. Recognizes CLIENT_TRAFFIC_SECRET_0 and SERVER_TRAFFIC_SECRET_0 (each <label> <client_random_hex> <secret_hex>); ignores blanks, comments (# ...), and other labels (handshake/early/exporter). Raises ValueError on malformed traffic-secret lines.
